summary: Assess property evidence, model cash flows and present investment decisions. Explore this five-day real estate appraisal course.
lede: Real estate investment appraisal helps acquisition analysts, asset managers and development surveyors compare property evidence and support capital decisions. You will assess comparable transactions, build income and discounted cash-flow models in Excel, and calculate NPV and IRR. You will also test sensitivities and document assumptions, risks and evidence gaps for investment committee decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for real estate professionals who assess property acquisitions, development proposals, income assets or investment recommendations. It suits intermediate practitioners who work with property financial information and want a more traceable appraisal process.
prerequisites: Prior experience with property income, costs or investment analysis is expected. No programming is required. You will need access to Excel and a laptop for spreadsheet exercises.
